name: Supabase
tagline: Postgres, auth, storage, edge functions, and realtime.
shortDescription: A Postgres-backed app platform with strong docs, local CLI, generated types, and broad APIs.
agentSummary: Agents can create schemas, run local stacks, manage migrations, generate types, query projects, inspect logs, and use Supabase's hosted MCP server with read-only and project-scoped options.
bestFor: App backends, database-first prototypes, auth, storage, and realtime features.
cautionNotes: Key limitations: RLS policies require careful review before exposing data. Schema changes, migrations, deletes, backups, row-level security, and retention policies need explicit review before agents touch production data. MCP servers inherit the connected account's scopes and may send prompts or data to third-party services; configure read-only or narrow scopes when available. CLI access is powerful but can run destructive local or production commands; prefer dry runs, preview environments, and non-production credentials.
pricingSummary: Public project-based pricing with free tier and usage add-ons.
authModel: Project API keys, JWTs, service role keys, OAuth providers, and hosted MCP OAuth or access-token auth.
accountCreation: Self-serve signup; organizations and billing for production scale.
browserSupport: Dashboard is strong for setup and inspection.

capabilities.detail: CLI supports local dev, migrations, generated types, functions, and linking.
Official Supabase MCP server covers database, debugging, development, Edge Functions, branching, and docs tools with scope/read-only controls.
Official docs are listed for API behavior, authentication, limits, examples, and setup review.
Public project-based pricing with free tier and usage add-ons.
Self-serve signup; organizations and billing for production scale.
Dashboard is strong for setup and inspection.
Local Docker stack is excellent for agent-safe development.
PostgREST, auth, storage, realtime, and management APIs are documented.
